# KhulnaSoft AI Engineering Cloud (full)

## AI Code Assistant (ai-agent)
- Summary: An AI agent that navigates the context fabric and control plane to summarize architecture, review Posture, and answer engineering questions.
- Owner: AI Enablement | Workspace: ai | Lifecycle: beta
- Capabilities: ai-agent, context-retrieval, review, assistant
- Relationships: uses resource:context-fabric; uses resource:ai-runtime
- Health: 85/100 (healthy)
- Rendering: 2026-08-07

## AI Runtime Services (ai-runtime)
- Summary: Runtime services that compose context, invoke agents, and provide reusable AI capabilities across the engineering cloud.
- Owner: KhulnaSoft | Workspace: core | Lifecycle: active
- Capabilities: context-fabric, agent-runtime, prompt-registry, mcp
- Relationships: depends_on resource:khulnasoft-platform
- Health: 82/100 (healthy)
- Rendering: 2026-08-07

## API Gateway (api)

## Checkout Service (service)
- Summary: BFF for checkout flows: cart orchestration, payment intent creation, and idempotent order placement.
- Owner: Commerce | Workspace: commerce | Lifecycle: supported
- Capabilities: microservice, api, payment, messaging
- Relationships: depends_on resource:orders-db; depends_on resource:payment-events
- Health: 88/100 (healthy)
- Rendering: 2026-08-07

## Context Fabric (component)
- Summary: Composes layered, AI-ready context by metadata, architecture, dependency, API, deployment, runtime, observability, security, and business layers, supporting selective retrieval.

- Rendering: 2026-08-07
